changes.comment: Fix PNPM catalog handling for subspaces that do not have their own pnpm-config.json. The repo-state.json catalog hash, catalog change detection, and the "rush-pnpm update" catalog sync now use common/config/rush/pnpm-config.json as a fallback, the same way "rush install" does. When the catalogs in a pnpm-config.json shared by several subspaces are synced, entries are only added or updated, and Rush lists the other subspaces that need "rush update".
